title: AODB Data Restoration Verification

fields.subject: URGENT: Pre-Go-Live Verification for FIDS Re-activation
fields.body:
IT,

We are preparing to restore FIDS displays across the terminal. Per I-13, you confirmed the AODB was restored from a 04:00 AM backup.

However, the script random_gate_generator.ps1 was executed prior to that backup, and its logic remains undetected in the file system. We must verify that the data being fed to FIDS is not still corrupted.

Before any screens are reactivated, we require a formal verification protocol. We cannot risk a recurrence of the fake Flight 666 to Purgatory broadcast.

Please confirm:

- Which gate(s) will be tested first on a controlled, isolated display?
- What data validation method will be used (e.g., compare to known-good flight manifest, check against the original FIDS log timestamp from 09:00 AM)?
- Who will perform the verification, and under what authority?

We will not proceed without written confirmation from IT that the data feed is clean and the verification plan is approved.

We are at 12:15 PM. The terminal is still dark. Passengers are demanding answers.

— Ops Director (IC)
fields.signature:
Ops Director (IC)
Airport Operations Center (AOC) | x1040

instructorNote: This inject forces IT to define a verification process before restoring FIDS. Watch for whether IT proposes a test gate (e.g., Gate 14, which was previously correct) and a data source (e.g., the original 09:00 AM manifest).
